proof_body:
by
  intro a ha
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp h
    refine h1.congr fun n => ?_
    simp
  · intro h
    rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop]
    intro M
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 h (1 / (|M| + 1)) (by positivity)
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨K, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have h3 := hK n hn
    have hpos := ha n
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (by positivity)] at h3
    have h4 := (one_div_lt_one_div hpos (by positivity)).1 h3
    linarith [le_abs_self M]
target_source: ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < a n) → (Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ↔ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 1 / a n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
